import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_death_rates_life_expectancy.csv')
white_females = df[(df['Year'] == 2010) & (df['Race'] == 'White') & (df['Sex'] == 'Female')]['Average Life Expectancy (Years)'].iloc[0]
black_females = df[(df['Year'] == 2010) & (df['Race'] == 'Black') & (df['Sex'] == 'Female')]['Average Life Expectancy (Years)'].iloc[0]
result = round(white_females - black_females, 2)
